about: Expected events, worked out from SuperCollider's semantics with a small script (sclang was not run). Tempo 1 beat per second. Each time round the loop (every 5 beats, for ever) p.play is a new playback, from the first note: degrees 0, 1, 2 (MIDI 60, 62, 64) at beats 5n, 5n + 1 and 5n + 2, each 1 * 0.8 beats long; x.stop at 5n + 2.5 ends it before its event at 5n + 3, so beats 5n + 2.5 to 5n + 5 are silent. Windows over many periods, before and well after the 512 beats the importer follows (beats 400 to 411, 1000 to 1011), check that every period has its gap and its three notes.
